0.5.0.title: Code blocks.
0.5.0.text: Code now has syntax highlighting, shows the language, and has a Copy button.

0.5.0.title: Tall media.
0.5.0.text: Images, videos and embeds stay centered and stay fully in-view.

0.5.0.title: Update notices.
0.5.0.text: When a newer release exists, a short note and link to update appears at the end of articles. Daisy and Daisy Sans check one small file on this project's GitHub Pages site at most once a day, and send nothing about you, your feeds or your articles.

0.5.0.title: Lead lists.
0.5.0.text: Links in a list at the start of a post no longer shift when you hover over them.
